responsibility: Implements the range-analysis engine used by early VRP/EVRP. The evrp_range_analyzer class tracks unwindable SSA value ranges while walking the dominator tree, records ranges implied by incoming conditional edges, PHIs, statements, inferred assertions, and selected cast chains, updates global range info when requested, and supports scoped push/pop restoration so folding and threading can query path-valid ranges without running a full iterative VRP solver.
same_name_distinction: Implements the evrp_range_analyzer methods declared in gcc/gimple-ssa-evrp-analyze.h, including dominator-walk entry/exit handling, recording ranges from incoming edges, PHIs, and statements, and maintaining the unwind stack of temporary ranges. The header just defines the class interface and stored state.
